info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Banking Enterprise Services Security Advisory By Security Advisory Id-v5-spec
info.description: This API provides access to the details of a specific security advisory within the Banking Enterprise Services. By using the security advisory ID, consumers can retrieve critical information regarding security assessments and recommendations that are essential for risk management. Typical users include security analysts and compliance officers who need to stay informed about vulnerabilities and recommended mitigations. This enables organizations to enhance their security posture and ensure compliance with industry standards.

get.description: This endpoint allows developers to fetch detailed information about a specific security advisory using its unique identifier. It provides insights into security vulnerabilities, recommendations, and related security measures.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to send parameters for retrieving security advisory information specific to the resource identified by RES-100045. The JSON payload should adhere to the structure defined in the associated schema.

200.description: Successful retrieval of the security advisory details.
